Mm. That's a good point, but it's not totally true.

For starters, downvoating content is limited to people with over 100 points. While seemingly insignificant, this means that other users don't necessarily determine the worth of your contributions. Other users that have made content worthy of upvotes determine the worth of your contributions. This results in people who are liked being able to influence the votes, and people who are unliked being unable to influence the votes.

You may say this is a good thing, but that's pretty much blatant censorship.

"As long as you are liked, you can have a voice."

Your comment points shouldn't influence anything other than your comment points. Your activity on the site is far more valuable and informative. I get the need to wall the ability to downvote behind something, but the current wall is just terrible.

As for the thought that you shouldn't determine the worth of your own contributions;

While you shouldn't have an influence over that, a contribution has some worth in and of itself. Just the act of making a comment is worthy of something. And if it ends up being in poor taste, it'll be downvoted and that meager upvote will have been just as insignificant as if it weren't downvoted.

In the end, a single comment point is entirely worthless, and the thought that other users determine the worth of your contributions through upvotes is.. absurd, to say the least.

Until you get decently geared your HoTs can't be your primary heal. Drop them on people that aren't below 50% and follow up with HT or Regrowth. When people are below 50% drop Regrowth then Rejuv and then even Regrowth again or healing touch.
